slides.title: Welcome to NeoPowerPoint
slides.notes: Introduce the presentation. Mention that every slide is an isolated, 100% standard web page running real JavaScript, CSS animations, and Canvas/WebGL.

slides.title: Interactive Data Visualizer
slides.notes: Demonstrate the interactive chart. Click the buttons to switch metrics and observe real-time dynamic re-rendering with smooth animation.

slides.title: 3D Canvas Particle Physics
slides.notes: Show off the high performance canvas simulation. Hover and drag your mouse to interact with the gravitational particle field.

slides.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
slides.notes: Run the algorithm visualizer by clicking Start or Step. Slides can contain fully functional educational tools, demos, and simulations.
